items.t: AMD or Intel: 1 Chip Stock Is the Clear Winner
Why Advanced Micro Devices Stock Is Down Today
items.sum: AMD stock is sinking as the chip sector sells off amid the Nvidia scandal, giving back part of the gains it picked up when Jensen Huang resigned. I think the fallout could last longer than many investors hope.

items.t: AMD Stocks Fall 6.46% After 30% Weekly Surge on Nvidia Leadership Shock
items.sum: The pullback trims a rally of roughly 30% this week, while Michael Burry publicly doubled his bet against the Nasdaq 100.

items.t: AMD Tumbles 11%, Broadcom and Intel Slide 6% as Chip Rally Reverses
items.sum: One day after NVIDIA's CEO shake-up handed its rivals a windfall, the winners are giving it back fast. Analysts and a famed skeptic disagree on what comes next, and the answer may hinge on who sold first.
